reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`lbipam_conflicting_pools_total` has been renamed to `lbipam_conflicting_pools`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The metric is exposed under the new name lbipam_conflicting_pools; queries, dashboards or alerts using lbipam_conflicting_pools_total need updating to the new name.
consequence.remediation: Update monitoring queries to use lbipam_conflicting_pools.

proposed.statement: The metric lbipam_conflicting_pools_total has been renamed to lbipam_conflicting_pools.
